I've been looking at the various cards, and I've come up with a (tentative) timeline.

1. The visionary comes from the future.  Along the way, she picks up the psychic hitchhiker soon to be known as "Dark Visionary".

     1a. Dark visionary is described as a version of Vanessa that "made very different choices."  The choices themselves are unknown.

     1b. did Dark visionary ditch her own body in order to hitch a ride?  Or does she exist only AS psychic energy?

 

2. Visionary gets her parents and the dreamer (not yet born) out of the program known as "Project Cocoon".

     2a. Part of Visionary's creation was the injection of the fetus with compound PSY-200.  it is unknown if the Dreamer was injected with this compound        before the rescue.

     2b. The Dreamer is born without any explosions of psychic energy.  She appears normal.

 

3. Visionary begins fighting alongside the F5 (and presumably on her own).  She is seen clashing with Baron blade, Dawn, and has visions of the Thorathian       invasion, so presumably she was involved in that as well. 

    3a. The rise of Dark visionary specifically takes place during a ritual with Gloomweaver cultists, before Gloomy had fully materialized.  Dark Visionary        was able to banish gloomweaver.  this suggests that it is the nightmare version, as opposed to the Skinwalker (as the Skinwalker is a zombie and has a        physical body, it is presubably much more difficult to make him go way with the wave of a hand).

 

4. Various Heroes start seeing projections.  it is uncertain when this starts happening, but it is likely before the events of the "Time Cataclysm".  

    4a. I think that "Nightmare world" is the equivalent of a massive crossover event.  Many heroes fight projections on their own, then figure out that they     are all connected and converge on the Dreamer.  

    4b. It is unknown if the Dark Visionary is still in control of the Visionary's body.  

    4c. The visionary meets the "Toy master" projection in "Mind over matter".  If this follows the crossover event pattern, Mind over matter would take           take place before nightmare world.  The visionary talks about it being thing she wanted to avoid...but is this DV talking, or the Visionary?

 

5. IF the Dark Visionary is in control of the Visionary's body, she would have access to the Dreamer (as she would know where she lived), as well as access     to the heroes. She could manipulate things behind the scenes.

    5a. It is entirely possible that the treacherous ape is the Visionary.  this could explain why that projection appeared to the F5 (who know her best, as         she has fought alongside them).

    5b. The ape could represent the Visionary fighting the Dark Visionary from within- unable to re-take her body, but able to provide clues as to the nature     of the threat.  The out-of-place ape (that resembled the Dreamer's stuffed toy), and the green crystal that resembled the Telekinetic Cocoon.  The           fact that it attacked in a burst of green emnergy (which is EXACTLY how the emergence of Dark Visionary is described from the Telekinetic Cocoon) 

 

6. During the Nightmare world, the Dark visionary transfers to the mind of the Dreamer (signified by the glowing green eyes on "The Dreamer Wakes")

    6a. Best guess is that while the Dark Visionary controls her waking body, the Dreamer has gone walkabout in other people's minds- the only time we            actually hear her talk is on "Projected Paralysis", which is during "Nightmare World # 5". In that one, we see the Dreamer walking around, but emitting        purple energy (as opposed to the green/yellow of the Dark Visionary).  This might be her "core" self, lost. 

    6b. "Nightmare World #5" appears to be the last comic of the crossover, as that is when we hear the dreamer talk, and see the Scholar protecting her       (with her eyes open and glowing green).  

 

7. The Dreamer reclaims her mind, casting out the Dark Visionary (because of the presence of Omnitron X, it seems possible that this is during the Nightmare World crossover).  This is a "Fixed point", and by throwing out an extradimensinoal time traveling psychic entity, the Dreamer shatters the walls of time and space, creating the Time Cataclysm.

 

Does anyone see any major holes in this?
